annotation.evidence_span: can use any application error code
annotation.interpretation_a: The endpoint must use the error code from the STOP_SENDING frame when sending the RESET_STREAM frame.
annotation.interpretation_b: The endpoint is allowed to override the STOP_SENDING error code with any application-specific error code in the RESET_STREAM frame.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'can use any application error code' introduces ambiguity about whether the error code from the STOP_SENDING frame is mandatory or optional. This allows for two materially different interpretations: one where the error code is required to be copied, and another where it is optional and can be replaced.
